metrics.method: Full history 2026-05-25 to 2026-09-10, 1054 lines (1045 messages + 9 service events); 686 Lilia / 359 our side. Lilia is the only client_aliases sender; every other sender maps to team.yaml (fred SPITFIRE/OFM, Stephski, Mayson Chat, Mica Vecco, Michelle Queue, Derrek, Vivek, Eric The Efficient) so the whole non-Lilia side is ALTR. client_questions_total = Lilia messages containing '?' (60) or an explicit ask keyword (please / can u / can you / let me know / make sure / tell the chatter / have the chatter / not to sell) = 106. unanswered_over_24h: for each ask, the next non-ping team message in the same Telegram topic thread (bare '@name ^' escalations from Mayson excluded as replies) - 17 exceeded 24h, minus 3 that are acknowledgements rather than asks, plus the 08-24 23:31-23:50 'Facebook' screenshot report that no keyword catches and that nobody has ever acknowledged = 15. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive messages from any ALTR sender (2026-08-04 15:42 -> 2026-08-09 00:23 = 4.36d); Fred's own longest gap is 7.0d (06-29 -> 07-06) and he is at 7.1d and counting at report close (last message 2026-09-04 10:22). Promises = explicit forward commitments by our side ('I will', 'we'll', 'I'll speak to the team and...', 'will inform team'); counted kept only where the chat shows delivery or clear non-recurrence, lapsed where the same failure recurred or the item was never mentioned again by anyone. 2 further commitments were voided by the client (the cancelled OF live) and are excluded.
